Package com.j3d.engine.interact

package com.j3d.engine.interact
Package that holds all subsystems which allow the user to interact with the engine in various different ways that aren't purely via UI. This includes:
  • Anything and everything related to the command line com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd
  • Any input the user gives to UI that we'd like to intercept.
    invalid reference 
    com.j3d.engine.interact.input
  • All selection related classes and helpers com.j3d.engine.interact.selection
